description: This file defines a utility class 'SecurityTestUtils' for testing security-related functionality within the book project. It provides methods to retrieve or insert a test user into a UserRepository, with a predefined test email.

classes.name: SecurityTestUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for handling test user data in security tests, including retrieving and inserting a test user with a fixed email.

methods.name: getTestUser
methods.description: Retrieves the test user from the repository by email, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: insertTestUser
methods.description: Creates and saves a new test user in the repository with predefined email and password.
